app_subtitle: Combustion knowledge-gap mapper for NASA PSI investigations (prototype)
api_unreachable: The API is not reachable at {url}. Start it with: uv run fif-app api
lim_draft_mappings: {n} experimental trials come from draft M2 table mappings that have not been reviewed: trial-based results are provisional.
lim_provisional_scenarios: {n} scenarios use provisional, configurable parameters (assumptions marked); they are not official specifications.
lim_exploratory_tolerances: 'Near' tolerances ({version}) are exploratory, not a physical criterion.
lim_gravity_not_recorded: Gravity is not recorded for any of the {n} trials; investigation type is shown only as context, never as a trial condition.
lim_text_not_extracted: Only {extracted} of {units} selected text units have been processed by the extraction so far: absence of findings is mostly a processing gap.
lim_findings_unreviewed: {machine_verified} findings are machine-verified (quote and numbers found in the source) but NOT scientifically reviewed; {confirmed} are scientifically confirmed.
lim_similarity_not_discriminative: Text similarity (threshold {tau}) does not discriminate well yet: 'related topic' links are exploratory candidates.
lim_singularity_uncalibrated: Singularity (a finding with no counterpart in other investigations) depends on an uncalibrated similarity threshold: no candidates does not mean no singular findings exist.
gap_declared_note: These {n} entries are automatic extractions of limitations and future work stated by the authors, verified only against the text and not scientifically reviewed. They are not confirmed scientific gaps.
claim_withheld_nd: (automatic reformulation not published: the source licence does not allow derivatives; see the verbatim quote)
src_nd_note: No-derivatives (ND) licence: only the verbatim quote is shown, with attribution; the model reformulation is not published.
exp_truncated: Showing the first {n} findings; there are more. Filter by investigation, type or text to see the rest.
related_topic_hidden: {n} more 'related_topic' links are not shown (text similarity only, non-discriminative threshold). Links to other investigations and independent ones come first.
new_singular_uncalibrated: Singularity is NOT calibrated (similarity threshold τ = {tau}, provisional): {n} candidates flagged. An empty list does not mean there are no singular findings.
lim_relations_provisional: All relations between findings are provisional until scientifically reviewed; contradictions are only candidates.
cov_intro: Per investigation: documents and their text level, experimental tables and trials (from M2), and text processing / findings (M4).
gap_cut: 2-D cut: O2 × pressure (trials with both values recorded)
gap_cut_missing: {n} trials do not record O2 and pressure together and cannot be placed in this cut (not counted as outside).
gap_dim_not_evaluated: {dims}: the scenario defines no numeric range (regime: {regime}), so this dimension is not evaluated; its zeros mean neither coverage nor missing data.
gap_status_legend: in_range = value inside; overlaps = a trial range only touches the scenario (not coverage); near = within the exploratory tolerance; outside; unknown = not recorded.
fam_scientific_possible: Possible scientific gaps (within the processed corpus, provisional)
gap_scientific_note: A possible knowledge gap is only stated where processed sources record the condition and none is in or near the scenario; open system gaps can change it.
gap_declared: Gaps declared by the authors (future work / limitations; automatic extraction)
study_contrast_note: Scientific relation types require the same normalised variable and effect, stated directions and conditions compared by code. 'related_topic' is text similarity only (exploratory).
study_none: No relations with other investigations yet.
gap_dims: Trials recording each condition vs the scenario range (red band)
